blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Image editing models can follow a wide range of instructions, but video editing models still lag behind, limited in part by the difficulty of collecting paired source and edited videos. Is it possible to transfer advanced image editing capabilities to video editors without new paired videos? We introduce Image-to-Video Transfer (I2VT), which improves pretrained video editors and expands them to new editing tasks using an image editor. It enables efficient post-training with no architectural changes and no new videos, using only individual images. Our key idea is to let the video editor role-play as an image editor: it edits an image as a one-frame video, with the image editor guiding the video editor's predictions at each denoising step. Although the video editor sees only single images during training, at test time it applies the improved and expanded capabilities to whole video clips while preserving temporal consistency. To push the boundaries of video editing, we introduce OpenVE++, an extension of OpenVE-Bench that adds four new editing tasks useful for video production, including action changes, expression changes, body movements, and scene relighting. Our experiments across three different video editors show that I2VT improves existing editing capabilities and expands them to new tasks, and our models achieve state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance on both OpenVE-Bench and OpenVE++.

blocks.en:
Recent image editing models have advanced rapidly and can follow detailed instructions and offer fine-grained control over a wide range of edits [ 58 , 68 , 5 , 89 , 110 , 17 , 4 , 73 , 8 ] .
This progress has been supported by increasingly diverse image editing datasets [ 6 , 106 , 111 , 103 , 87 ] .
However, current video editors [ 13 , 93 , 116 , 28 , 2 , 24 ] still perform only moderately well on basic edit types such as object removal. They struggle even more with edits that change a person’s actions, facial expressions, body movements, or a scene’s lighting, although video production often needs these edits [ 7 , 63 , 107 , 115 , 18 ] ( Figure 2 , left).
blocks.zh:
近期的图像编辑模式迅速发展,可以遵循详细指示,并对广泛的编辑提供精细的控制[58,68,5,89,110,17,4,73,8].
这一进展得到了日益多样化的图像编辑数据集[6、106、111、103、87]的支持。
然而,目前的视频编辑[13,93,116,28,2,24]在取出物体等基本编辑类型上的表现仍然比较好. 尽管录像制作经常需要编辑[7、63、107、115、18](图2,左)。

blocks.en:
This gap remains even though modern image and video editors are built in similar ways: they use the same flow-matching objective and similar diffusion transformer (DiT) architectures [ 64 ] , and many recent models also share a variational autoencoder (VAE) [ 37 ] latent space [ 77 , 89 , 79 , 100 ] .
One reason video editors still lag behind is training data. A good training pair for video editing must include an edited video that follows the instruction closely over the whole clip while leaving unrelated regions unchanged. Yet current data pipelines struggle to produce such videos, especially when edits become complex and diverse [ 2 , 7 , 62 ] .
This raises a question: can a video editor improve its existing editing capabilities and expand them to new tasks without new paired videos?
blocks.zh:
尽管现代图像和视频编辑器的构建方式相似:它们使用相同的相流相配目标以及相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相传播的变压器(DiT)架构[64],但这一差距依然存在;而许多近期的模型也共享了可变自编码器(VAE)[37]潜在空间[77,89,79,100].
视频编辑仍然落后的一个原因是培训数据。 录像编辑的良好培训组合必须包括一段经过编辑的录像,该录像在整段片段上密切遵循指示,而无关区域则保持不变。 特别是当编辑变得复杂多样[2,7,62]时。
这提出了一个问题:一个视频编辑器能否提高它现有的编辑能力,将其扩展为没有新配对视频的新任务?

blocks.en:
To answer this question, we introduce Image-to-Video Transfer ( I2VT ), which efficiently improves and expands a pretrained video editor using only images instead of new paired videos.
Our intuition is that an image is simply a one-frame video, so editing images well could be a foundation for editing videos well.
We therefore let the video editor role-play as an image editor : it edits a source image as a one-frame video under the supervision of a frozen image editor.
A direct way to give this supervision is offline distillation, which fine-tunes the video editor on the image editor’s pre-computed edit results. I2VT instead lets the image editor tell the video editor how to update its current noisy prediction at each step of its own denoising trajectory ( Figure 3 ).
Although the video editor sees only single images during training, at test time it applies the improved and expanded capabilities to whole video clips while preserving temporal consistency ( Figure 1 ).
blocks.zh:
为了回答这个问题,我们引入了图像到视频传输(I2VT),它高效地改进并扩展了预先训练的视频编辑器,只使用图像而不是新配对的视频.
我们的直觉是,一个图像只是一个框架的视频,因此,编辑图像可以很好地成为编辑视频的基础。
因此,我们让视频编辑角色扮演作为图像编辑器:它在一个被冻结的图像编辑器的监督下,将源图像编辑为一帧视频.
直接给予这种监督的方法是离线蒸馏,它微调了图像编辑器预计算编辑结果上的视频编辑器. I2VT让图像编辑器告诉视频编辑器如何在自己去Noing轨迹的每个步骤上更新其目前的噪音预测(图3).
虽然视频编辑员在培训期间只看到单个图像,但在测试时,它将改进后和扩大的能力应用于整个视频片段,同时保持时间一致性(图一)。

blocks.en:
To push the boundaries of video editing, we introduce OpenVE++ , an extension of OpenVE-Bench [ 24 ] that adds four editing tasks useful for video production: Action Change , Expression Change , Body Movement , and Scene Relighting ( Figure 4 ). These tasks test whether video editors can change a person’s performance and a scene’s lighting, which video production often requires [ 7 , 63 , 115 ] .
Across three video editors, our experiments show that I2VT improves basic edits and enables new tasks that their pretrained base editors barely perform, and the resulting models achieve state-of-the-art (SOTA) results among the open-source video editors we compare.
Our contributions are as follows: ∙ \bullet We propose I2VT, which improves and expands pretrained video editors by letting them role-play as image editors, without new paired videos or architecture changes. ∙ \bullet We introduce OpenVE++ , an extension of OpenVE-Bench that adds four new editing tasks useful for video production: action changes, expression changes, body movements, and scene relighting. ∙ \bullet We validate I2VT across three video editing models: editing capabilities improved and expanded with single images generalize to whole video clips while preserving temporal consistency, and the resulting models achieve SOTA results on OpenVE-Bench and OpenVE++.

blocks.en:
Image-to-Video Transfer (I2VT ) lets a pretrained video editor role-play as an image editor : it edits an individual image as a one-frame video , with a frozen image editor guiding its predictions at each denoising step.
During fine-tuning, the video student takes one source image and an editing instruction at a time.
I2VT matches the teacher’s velocity predictions on the student’s own denoising trajectory. As a baseline, we also consider offline distillation, which fine-tunes the student on source and edited image pairs prepared by the image teacher.

blocks.en: 2.3 I2VT
blocks.zh: 2.3 二维T

blocks.en:
I2VT is designed to fine-tune the video student along its own denoising trajectory with supervision from an image editor: the student edits each source image as a one-frame video from noise, and the teacher guides its prediction at each step.
We take advantage of the shared VAE latent space used by existing image and video models, including JoyAI-Image-Edit, Qwen-Image, Wan2.1, and Wan2.2-14B [ 77 , 89 , 80 , 83 ] , which lets the teacher predict a target velocity directly from the student’s noisy latent.
blocks.zh:
I2VT的设计是为了在图像编辑器的监督下,将视频学生沿自己的去Noing轨迹进行微调:学生将每个源图像编辑为来自噪音的一帧视频,老师指导其每一步的预测.
我们利用现有图像和视频模型(包括JoyAI-Image-Edit、Quen-Image、Wan2.1和Wan2.2-14B[77、89、80、83])使用的共享VAE潜在空间,让老师直接从学生的喧闹潜伏中预测出目标速度。

blocks.en: 2.4 Task and Training Data

blocks.en:
We build I2VT-17K by sampling individual frames from OpenVE-3M [ 24 ] , a dataset already commonly used to train video editors [ 49 , 108 ] .
We organize these images and their instructions into two pools: the OpenVE pool for basic edits and the OpenVE++ pool for four new task groups. Action Change covers head, gaze, and arm edits where the person stays in place, distinct from Body Movement , which involves whole-person movements like crouching, jumping, sitting down, standing up, and turning ( Figure 4 ). Expression Change covers facial expressions such as sadness, happiness, and anger, and Scene Relighting changes the light type and direction.

blocks.en: 3.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 3.1 实验设置

blocks.en: We evaluate I2VT on Bernini-R-1.3B [ 79 ] , Bernini-R-14B, and VideoCoF [ 100 ] , using the powerful image editor JoyAI-Image-Edit [ 77 ] as their shared teacher. The teacher and students share the 16-channel Wan 2.1 VAE latent representation [ 80 ] , and their detailed architecture descriptions are in the appendix.

blocks.en: We fine-tune each base editor for 200 steps with low-rank adaptation (LoRA) [ 27 ] , where each I2VT update uses K = 10 K=10 rollout steps per image and a global batch size of 24 24 , or 48 48 when training jointly on both pools. Because training on single frames instead of videos reduces the number of visual tokens and lowers the cost of spatiotemporal attention, fine-tuning takes only 20 A100 GPU-hours for Bernini-R-1.3B and 20–25 B300 GPU-hours for Bernini-R-14B and VideoCoF.

blocks.en: 3.2 Evaluation Benchmarks and Metrics
blocks.zh: 3.2 评价基准和计量

blocks.en: Existing video editing benchmarks mainly evaluate basic edit types. Inspired by ImgEdit-Bench [ 102 ] and GEdit-Bench [ 53 ] , we introduce OpenVE++, which extends OpenVE-Bench with four new categories defined in Section 2.4 . OpenVE++ comprises 207 video–instruction pairs across four categories (42–73 per category), keeping category sizes roughly balanced and matching the per-category scale of OpenVE-Bench [ 24 ] . Each category covers diverse fine-grained edits, and all source videos are strictly disjoint between the training and evaluation splits. Figure 4 illustrates group sizes and examples for these categories.
blocks.zh: 现有的视频编辑基准主要评价基本的编辑类型. 在ImgEdit-Bench [102]和Gedit-Bench [53]的启发下,我们引入了OpenVE++,将OpenVE-Bench扩展为2.4节所定义的四个新类别. OpenVE++包含207个视频-指令对分4个类别(每类42–73个),保持类别大小大致平衡并匹配OpenVE-Bench的每个类别尺度[24]. 每个类别都覆盖了各种精细的编辑,所有源视频在培训和评价分割之间严格脱节. 图4说明了这些类别的组群规模和实例。

blocks.en: Following the OpenVE-Bench protocol [ 24 ] , we evaluate basic editing on OpenVE-Bench and new abilities on OpenVE++. Our automatic evaluation combines two complementary dimensions: (i) Semantic and visual alignment , using Gemini 2.5 Pro [ 20 ] and Gemini 3.8 Flash to rate instruction compliance, source consistency, and visual quality, and (ii) Temporal consistency and motion dynamics , using widely adopted VBench [ 30 ] metrics (Sec. 4.3 ). Together, they jointly capture editing fidelity and motion execution. We use Gemini 2.5 Pro to score edits before and after fine-tuning and to compare distillation methods, guidance scales, and training losses. For the comparison with existing editors ( Table 3 ), we report scores from Gemini 2.5 Pro on OpenVE-Bench and from both Gemini 2.5 Pro and Gemini 3.8 Flash on OpenVE++. Evaluation details, Gemini prompts, and a user study validating alignment with human judgments are provided in the appendix.
blocks.zh: 根据OpenVE-Bench协议[24],我们评价OpenVE-Bench上的基本编辑和OpenVE++上的新能力. 我们的自动评价将两个相辅相成的方面结合起来:(一)语义和视觉相配,利用双子座2.5 Pro [20]和双子座3.8 Flash来评定指令遵守率、源一致性和视觉质量,(二)时间一致性和运动动态,使用被广泛采纳的V Bench [30] 度量衡(第4.3节)。 他们共同捕捉编辑忠诚和动议处决。 我们使用双子座2.5 Pro在微调前后进行分数编辑,并比较蒸馏方法,指导尺度,和训练损失. 为了与现有的编辑(表3)进行比较,我们报告OpenVE-Bench上的双子座2.5 Pro和OpenVE+上的双子座2.5 Pro和双子座3.8 Flash的分数. 评价细节,双子座提示,以及用户研究验证与人类判断的一致性,载于附录.

blocks.en: 5 Related Work
blocks.zh: 5 相关工作

blocks.en: Early video editors adapt a text-to-image or text-to-video prior at inference time without paired editing data, through inversion [ 56 , 65 , 52 , 9 , 14 ] , attention control and sharing across frames [ 25 , 36 , 109 , 35 , 46 , 31 , 99 ] , or feature propagation [ 21 , 97 , 15 , 98 , 85 ] , and some tune the model or a video representation on each source video [ 92 , 10 , 59 ] . Learning-based editors instead fine-tune a pretrained video backbone [ 80 , 38 , 101 , 23 ] on synthetic source, instruction, and target triplets [ 13 , 93 , 116 , 28 , 2 , 24 , 108 , 100 , 48 , 113 ] or attach task adapters to it [ 33 ] , and recent unified models combine generation and editing across modalities [ 88 , 34 , 78 , 11 , 61 , 49 , 90 , 57 , 51 , 29 ] .
blocks.zh: 早期的视频编辑器在推论时间前对一款文本到图像或文本到视频进行改编,没有配对的编辑数据,通过倒置[56,65,52,9,14],注意力控制和跨帧共享[25,36,109,35,46,31,99],或特写传播[21,97,15,98,85],并一些调谐模型或每个源视频上的视频表现[92,10,59]. 以学习为主的编辑则对预先培训的视频主干线进行微调[80,38,101,23] 关于合成源,指令,以及目标三进制[13,93,116,28,2,24,108,100,48,113]或附加任务适配器[33],近期的统一模式将生成和编辑结合起来,跨模式[88,34,78,11,61,49,90,57,51,29].

blocks.en:
Image editors also help construct paired training videos by editing a source frame and using a video model to generate the edited clip [ 2 , 79 , 86 ] .
However, training data still concentrate on basic edit types such as object addition, removal, replacement, and style transfer [ 2 , 24 ] , while reliably changing a subject’s actions, expressions, or body movements remains difficult.
blocks.zh:
图像编辑员还通过编辑源框和使用视频模型生成编辑剪辑[2,79,86],帮助构建配对培训视频.
然而,培训数据仍然集中在基本的编辑类型上,例如对象添加、去除、替换和风格转移[2,24],同时可靠地改变对象的行动、表达或身体运动仍然困难。

blocks.en:
Paired image editing data are far more abundant than paired video edits [ 6 , 106 , 111 , 103 , 87 ] , and many prior works bring them to video.
One group edits the first frame with an image editor and fine-tunes an image-to-video (I2V) or video diffusion model to propagate the edit, either on each source video [ 60 ] or by training added modules on videos [ 62 , 74 , 42 ] .
Another group trains on image editing pairs by repeating frames or warping them into synthetic motion [ 86 , 105 ] , uses image edit pairs as in-context examples [ 66 ] , or mixes image and video training in unified editors [ 94 , 34 , 88 , 69 , 11 , 55 ] .
A third group modifies the architecture of pretrained image or video generative models, or adds adapters to them, to enable video editing [ 76 , 96 , 104 , 3 ] .
In contrast, I2VT fine-tunes an existing video editor directly on single source images along its own denoising trajectory, as in on-policy distillation [ 71 , 1 , 19 , 44 , 114 , 43 ] , without constructing video targets, engineering artificial motion, or altering the core architecture.
blocks.zh:
Paired图像编辑数据远比配对视频编辑[6,106,111,103,87]更为丰富,许多前作将其带入视频.
一组用图像编辑器编辑第一帧,并微调图像到视频(I2V)或视频传播模式来传播编辑内容,要么在每个源视频上[60],要么在视频上培训新增模块[62,74,42].
另一组在图像编辑配对上的列车通过重复帧或将相框扭曲为合成运动[86,105],使用图像编辑配对作为内文本示例[66],或将图像和视频培训混合到统一编辑[94,34,88,69,11,55].
第三组修改了预先训练的图像或视频基因模型的架构,或添加了适配器来进行视频编辑[76,96,104,3].
相形之下,I2VT按照自己的去名轨迹,将现有的视频编辑器直接在单一源图像上进行微调,如在政策分解[71, 1, 19, 44, 114, 43]中,不构建视频目标,工程人工运动,也不改变核心架构.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: We introduced I2VT, which transfers image editing capabilities to pretrained video editors using only individual source images, without paired videos or architectural changes. Across three video editors, it improves basic edits and enables new editing tasks, while outperforming offline distillation in matched comparisons. These gains carry over to whole video clips, showing that image editing supervision can improve video editing without new video training pairs.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了I2VT,它将图像编辑能力转移给只使用单个源图像的预先训练的视频编辑器,没有配对的视频或建筑改变. 它通过三个视频编辑器,改进了基本编辑,并使得能够执行新的编辑任务,同时在匹配的比较中比脱机蒸馏效果要好. 这些收益延续到整个视频剪辑,显示图像编辑监督可以改善视频编辑,而无需新的视频培训对等.

blocks.en: Appendix A Discussion
blocks.zh: 讨论

blocks.en: A.1 Relation to Other Work
blocks.zh: A.1 与其他工作的关系

blocks.en: Three lines of work are closest to I2VT: video editors trained from image pairs instead of videos, editors trained without edited targets, and on-policy distillation from image models into video models.
blocks.zh: 三行工作最接近I2VT:从图像对而不是视频训练的视频编辑,在没有编辑目标的情况下训练的编辑,以及从图像模型到视频模型的政策分解.

blocks.en: ViFeEdit [ 104 ] and ImVideoEdit [ 96 ] also learn video editing without video data. Both build a new video editor from the text-to-video model Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B by adding spatial attention modules, keeping the pretrained 3D attention frozen, and fine-tuning on synthetic image-edit pairs treated as single-frame videos, with edited targets rendered in advance by an image editor. I2VT differs from them in three ways. First, instead of building a new editor from a text-to-video model, we keep the architecture unchanged and strengthen existing instruction-based video editors with a LoRA. Second, we need no edited targets because an existing frozen image editor acts as the teacher and supervises the student’s own denoising rollout at every step. Third, while both works evaluate only appearance edits (style, replacement, color, addition, and removal, plus relighting and background replacement in ImVideoEdit) on their own test sets, we extend editing to action, expression, and body-movement edits . Because these edits change how a subject moves across frames, they demand strong temporal consistency, and we show that the temporal quality of the edited videos stays on par with that of the base editors ( Tables 8 and 9 ). We do not compare with ViFeEdit or ImVideoEdit directly, since ImVideoEdit released no code and ViFeEdit released code without trained weights.
blocks.zh: ViFeEdit [104]和ImVideoEdit [96] 也学习没有视频数据的视频编辑. 两人从文本到视频模型新建了视频编辑器 Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B通过增加空间注意模块,使预训的3D注意被冷冻,并微调合成的图像-编辑对被作为单帧视频处理,由图像编辑器提前提供被编辑的目标. I2VT在三个方面与它们不同. 首先,我们不是从文本到视频模式建造出一个新的编辑器,而是保持架构不变,并用LORA加强现有的以教学为基础的视频编辑器. 校对:Soup 第三,虽然两部作品都只评价外观编辑(风格、替换、颜色、添加和去除,加上ImVideoEdit中的再光和背景替换)在自己的测试集中,但我们将编辑扩展到动作、表达和身体运动编辑。 因为这些编辑方式改变了一个题材如何跨帧移动,它们要求强烈的时间一致性,我们显示,被编辑的视频的时间质量与基本编辑一样(表8和表9)。 我们并不直接与"ViFeEdit"或"ImVideoEdit"进行比较,因为"ImVideoEdit"没有发布代码,"ViFeEdit"没有经过训练的权重就发布了代码.

blocks.en: EVE [ 76 ] also trains a video editor without supervised video data, building it from a text-to-image model and distilling from two adapters on that model, an image-editing adapter for per-frame edits and a video-generation adapter for temporal consistency. In contrast, we strengthen an existing video editor without changing its architecture, using a single frozen image editor and no second teacher , and temporal quality still stays on par with the base editors. BYG [ 81 ] uses no external teacher at all and trains flow-matching editors without paired examples from the frozen base model’s own instruction-following cues and cycle consistency, whereas our external image editor can also teach edits that the base video editor does not yet make well , such as edits that change how a subject moves. UIP2P [ 75 ] and NP-Edit [ 41 ] also train editors without edited targets, though they work only on images.
blocks.zh: EVE [76] 也培训一个没有被监督的视频数据的视频编辑器,从文本到图像模型构建,并从该模型上的两个适配器中分馏出,一个用于每帧编辑的图像编辑适配器和一个用于时间一致性的视频生成适配器. 相反,我们加强现有的视频编辑器,而不改变其结构,使用一个单一的被冻结的图像编辑器,没有第二个教师,而时间质量仍然与基础编辑一样。 BYG [81] 完全不用外部老师, 训练流程匹配编辑, 而不从被冻结的基底模型本身的指令提示和周期一致性中配对实例, 而我们的外部图像编辑器也可以教授编辑, UIP2P [75]和NP-Edit [41] 也培训没有被编辑的目标的编辑,尽管他们只工作在图像上.

blocks.en: MILD [ 32 ] improves text-to-video generation with image experts for composition, aesthetics, and text rendering. Its student rolls out whole videos, and the image experts supervise slices of the video latents along that rollout. Because its image and video models use different VAEs, MILD learns connectors to map those slices into the image latent space, anchors the transferred corrections to a frozen copy of the video model, and adds an optical-flow motion reward. In contrast, I2VT rolls out single images : our video editor role-plays as an image editor and edits each source image as a one-frame video, the same input the image editor receives. Since the teacher and the students share a VAE latent space, we need no connectors, and training renders no multi-frame videos.
blocks.zh: MILD [32] 改进了文本到视频的生成,并配备了图像专家,负责构思,美学和文本渲染. 学生们推出整个视频, 图像专家监督片段的视频潜伏 沿着推出。 由于其图像和视频模型使用不同的VAE,MILD学习连接器将这些片段映射入图像潜在空间,将转移的校正锁定到视频模型被冻结的副本上,并增加了光学流动奖励. 相形之下,I2VT推出单个图像:我们的视频编辑器角色扮演器作为图像编辑器,并将每个源图像作为一帧视频来编辑,图像编辑器接收的输入内容相同. 由于老师和学生们共享一个VAE潜在空间,我们不需要连接器,培训也不会产生多帧视频.

blocks.en: A.2 Constructing Paired Video Edits
blocks.zh: A.2 构建被保护的视频编辑器

blocks.en:
An editing pair needs a source video and a second video that differs from it only in the requested edit.
Such pairs almost never occur naturally [ 13 , 62 ] , so existing datasets synthesize them at a high cost [ 2 ] and mostly for appearance edits such as addition, removal, replacement, and style [ 24 , 7 ] .
Motion edits are harder still, because the target must change how a subject moves while the rest of the scene, the camera, and the timing follow the source.
blocks.zh:
编辑对需要源视频和第二个视频,这些视频仅在请求的编辑中与其不同.
这种对子几乎从未自然地发生[13,62],因此现有的数据集以高成本[2]合成了它们,并且大多用于外观编辑,如添加,去除,替换,和风格[24,7].
运动编辑仍然比较困难,因为目标必须改变一个主题在其余场景,相机,时间跟随源头时如何移动.

blocks.en:
A common shortcut edits one frame with an image editor and lets an image-to-video model generate the rest [ 40 , 60 ] .
These methods steer the image-to-video model with inverted source features [ 40 ] or per-video motion LoRAs [ 60 ] , and where this guidance is weak, the model regenerates the motion instead of keeping the source motion.
Content that is not visible in the first frame is hallucinated [ 7 ] , the result drifts from the source dynamics under camera or object motion [ 62 ] , and the quality of each pair is capped by the propagation model [ 2 ] .
Goku [ 47 ] builds part of its Subject Movement data in this way: an image editor moves the subject in the first frame, and a video model generates the clip from it.
For action changes, the same video model generates both the source and the target from two text descriptions, so the source is itself synthetic, which transfers poorly to real videos [ 93 ] .
Its filter discards about 88% of the generated samples, yet the released targets still do not follow the source motion ( Figure S1 ). Asked to lower a waving hand, the target lowers it and then freezes the person, and asked to turn the torso by 20 degrees, it replaces the whole dance.
I2VT builds no video targets: the student learns from single images and relies on the pretrained video editor for motion.
blocks.zh:
一个常见的快捷键会用图像编辑器编辑一个帧,让一个图像到视频模型生成其余 [40,60].
这些方法引导图像到视频模型具有倒向源特征[40]或per-video Movement LoRAs [60],而当这种向导薄弱时,模型会再生运动而不是保持源运动.
第一帧不可见的内容产生幻觉[7],结果从相机或物体运动下源动力学漂移[62],每对的质量被传播模型[2]所封顶.
悟空[47] 建造了它的一部分 主题运动数据以这种方式:一个图像编辑器在第一个帧中移动主题,一个视频模型从中生成剪辑.
对于动作变化,同一种视频模型从两个文本描述中同时生成出源和目标,所以源本身是合成的,它向真实的视频转移不良[93].
它的过滤器丢弃了大约88%所生成的样品,然而被放出的目标仍然没有遵循源运动(图S1). 被要求把挥手放下来,被目标放下来再将人冻住,并请求将躯干转20度,取而代之的是整个舞蹈.
I2VT构建了没有视频目标:学生从单一图像中学习,并依靠预先训练的视频编辑器来进行运动.

blocks.en: Appendix B Implementation Details
blocks.zh: 附录B 细节

blocks.en: Algorithm S1 One training step of I2VT
blocks.zh: 算法 S1 I2VT的一个培训步骤

blocks.en:
Bernini-R [ 79 ] adopts the Wan architecture [ 80 ] , including the Wan VAE and the UMT5 text encoder.
Bernini-R-1.3B follows Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B, and Bernini-R-14B follows the two-expert layout of Wan2.2-14B, which denoises high noise levels with one expert and low noise levels with the other.
To edit a video, Bernini-R places the source and target latents in one token sequence and gives the two segments different rotary position embeddings. It reads the instruction through cross-attention and denoises only the target tokens.
At inference, Bernini-R uses adaptive projected guidance (APG) [ 72 ] with separate scales for the source video ( 1.25 1.25 ), the image ( 4.5 4.5 ), and the text ( 4.0 4.0 ).
blocks.zh:
Bernini-R [79] 采用Wan架构 [80],包括Wan VAE和UMT5文本编码器.
伯尼尼-R-1.3B跟随了Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B,伯尼尼-R-14B跟随了Wan2.2-14B的两位专家布局,这两位专家用一位专家将高噪声同同高噪声同高叫声同高叫声同高叫声同高叫.
为了编辑一段视频,Bernini-R将源和目标潜伏物放入一个符号序列并给予两个段不同的回转位置嵌入. 它通过交叉注意来读取指示,而只取出目标符号.
推论,Bernini-R使用适应性预测指导(APG)[72],对源视频(1.25 1.25),图像(4.5 4.5 ),文本(4.0 4.0 )分别进行平分.

blocks.en:
VideoCoF [ 100 ] adapts Wan2.1-T2V-14B [ 80 ] with a LoRA for instruction-based editing without masks.
It arranges the source frames, a reasoning frame, and the edited frames in one sequence along the temporal axis and reads the instruction through cross-attention.
The reasoning frame marks the region to edit, so the model first predicts where to edit and then generates the edited frames.
Its rotary position embeddings align the edited frames with the source frames in time, which keeps the source motion and lets VideoCoF edit videos longer than its training clips. Following its official inference, VideoCoF samples in four steps with the FusionX acceleration LoRA for Wan2.1-T2V-14B [ 82 ] .
blocks.zh:
VideoCoF [100] 改编 Wan2.1-T2V-14B [80] 并配有LORA用于基于指令的无口罩编辑.
它按照时间轴以一个顺序排列出源帧,一个推理帧和被编辑的帧,并通过交叉注意来读取指令.
推理框架标出要编辑的区域,所以模型首先预测编辑地点,然后生成被编辑的框架.
它的回转位置嵌入使被编辑的帧与源帧及时相配合,这保持了源动,让VideoCoF编辑视频的时间比其训练剪辑长. 在其正式推论后,VideoCoF在FusionX加速度LORA为Wan2.1-T2V-14B [82] 分出四个步骤的样本.

blocks.en:
The student generates the reasoning and edited frames together, but the loss supervises only the edited frame.
In the loss equations, states and velocities therefore refer to the edited frame, whereas the rollout advances all generated frames.
blocks.zh:
学生生成推理并一起编辑帧,但损失只监督被编辑帧.
因此,在损失方程中,状态和速度是指经过编辑的框架,而推出则推进所有生成的框架。

The teacher is JoyAI-Image-Edit [ 77 ] , used frozen and without modification.

The image-edit instruction must describe an edit that makes sense for a single image, while the video-edit instruction may mention temporal consistency.
Feeding the video-edit instruction to the teacher, or the image-edit instruction to the student, puts one of the two models outside the input distribution it was trained on.

We build two training pools, the OpenVE pool and the OpenVE++ pool ( Table S2 ). Their union, I2VT-17K, trains I2VT-1.3B, I2VT-14B, and I2VT-CoF in Table 3 .
Both pools are source-only : a row holds one source frame, an image-edit instruction for the teacher, and a video-edit instruction for the student.
Offline distillation and I2VT train on the same source rows, and offline training additionally uses the teacher edits described below. Figure S3 shows how we build a new-task example.

我们建造了两个训练池,即OpenVE游泳池和OpenVE++游泳池(表S2)。 他们的联盟I2VT-17K,列车I2VT-1.3B,I2VT-14B,以及表3中的I2VT-CoF.
两个集合都是纯源的: 一行有1个源框,为老师提供图像编辑指导,为学生提供视频编辑指导.
离线蒸馏和I2VT列车在同一源行,离线培训额外使用下文描述的教师编辑. 图S3显示了我们如何构建一个新的任务示例.

blocks.en:
Every source frame is the first frame of a clip from OpenVE-3M [ 24 ] , at the clip’s resolution (mostly 1280 × 720 1280\times 720 ).
The videos are distributed as a split archive, so we take frames by streaming the archive and decoding each clip’s first frame in memory.
Before building a pool, we place every clip already used by an earlier pool, by OpenVE-Bench, or by OpenVE++ on an exclusion list. We use each remaining clip at most once within a pool, so no source appears under two instructions.
blocks.zh:
每个源框都是OpenVE-3M [24] 第一张剪辑的第一帧,在剪辑的分辨率(多为1280×720 1280\times 720).
录像以分块存档方式分发,
在建立游泳池之前,我们将先前游泳池,OpenVE-Bench,或OpenVE++已经使用的每一个剪辑都放入一个排除列表. 我们最多在游泳池里使用每个剩余片段 所以没有来源出现在两个指令下

blocks.en:
The OpenVE++ pool covers the four new task groups. We build its action, expression, and body-movement data in four stages.
(1) We extract frames from clips not on the exclusion list.
(2) A VLM (Qwen3.5-27B [ 67 ] ) describes each frame once, including the people in shot and their pose, gaze, expression, and visible arms.
(3) A frame is eligible for an edit if it shows one person with a visible face and upper body, does not already show the edit, and contains what the edit needs, such as the arm to be raised.
(4) We assign frames to the edits with the fewest eligible frames first to balance the pool.
We state directions in frame terms (“the arm on the left side of the frame”), because “turn to the left” leaves open whose left is meant and the teacher resolved it inconsistently.
The data cover 15 action and expression edits and five body-movement edits. We leave out turning to face the camera, for which only three frames were eligible.
blocks.zh:
OpenVE++池覆盖了四个新的任务组. 我们分四个阶段建立其行动、表达和身体运动数据。
(1) 我们从未列入排除名单的片段取出相框。
(2) VLM(Quen3.5-27B [67])一次描述每个相框,包括被射中的人及其姿势,目光,表情和可见臂.
(3)一个帧如果显示一个人有醒目的外相和上身,尚未显示编辑,并包含需要编辑的内容,如要提起的臂等,则有资格进行编辑.
(4)我们为编辑指定帧,并首先以最少的合格帧来平衡池.
我们用框架术语说明方向( " 框架左侧的手臂 " ),因为 " 向左转 " 的叶子是开着的,而老师却前后不一地解决了这个问题。
数据涵盖15个动作和表达式编辑和5个身体动作编辑. 我们离开 转身面对相机, 只有三个帧 有资格。

blocks.en:
The relighting data of the OpenVE++ pool ( 2,590 2{,}590 images) ask for a scene light, such as window sunlight, or a colored light, from one of up to ten directions, including front and back light. Most of the 35 light types in the Scene Relighting group of OpenVE++ also appear in training.
For most frames, the VLM first classifies the scene (indoor or outdoor, whether a window, water, or street is in shot, and the current light). We then assign only lights that are plausible for the scene and would change the image, so window sunlight goes only to indoor scenes with a window.
The student’s instruction ends with a clause asking to preserve the scene content, motion, and camera, whereas the teacher’s instruction omits motion.
blocks.zh:
OpenVE++池(2,590 2{,}590相片)的再点出数据,要求取出从上到后十个方向的一面来取出一面景光,如取出窗光等,或取出有色光. OpenVE++的Scene Relighting Group中的35个光型大多也出现在训练中.
对于大多数相框来说,VLM首先对场景进行分类(室内或室外,无论是窗道,水道,还是街道被打中,以及目前的光线). 然后我们只给场景配上可以想象的灯光 并且会改变画面, 所以窗光只用窗光照射室内场景。
学生的教学最后有一个条款要求保留场景内容、动作和相机,而老师的教学省略了动作。

blocks.en:
The OpenVE pool takes 6,026 source frames from the OpenVE-3M training split in seven categories ( Table S2 ). For the six categories that the training split covers, it keeps each clip’s original instruction as the student’s video-edit instruction.
The training split has no Creative Edit category, so we build its 1,326 rows with the same pipeline as the OpenVE++ pool: a VLM describes each frame and proposes a creative edit that suits it, written as separate instructions for the teacher and the student.
blocks.zh:
OpenVE池取自OpenVE-3M训练的6,026个源帧,分为7个类别(表S2. 对于培训分成的六类,它保留每个片段的原始教学作为学生的视频编辑教学。
培训划分没有创意编辑类,所以我们用与OpenVE++池相同的管道构建了1,326行:一个VLM描述每个帧并提议一个适合它的创造性编辑,作为老师和学生的单独指示来写.

blocks.en:
The teacher renders one edit per source image with 50 50 sampling steps and guidance 2 2 for every offline baseline.
We chose guidance 2 2 after rendering training frames at guidance 1 1 , 2 2 , and 5 5 with the same 50 50 steps ( Figure S4 ). At guidance 1 1 , the teacher can leave an edit undone, such as a requested frown or head turn. At guidance 5 5 , it over-edits by exaggerating expressions, removing objects the instruction does not mention, or moving the camera in background changes. Guidance 2 2 is a compromise between these two failure modes and gives stable edits, completing all three examples in Figure S4 without these side effects.
The teacher resizes its input to a fixed aspect bucket and center-crops what does not fit, so we crop the source to that bucket first and train the student against the cropped source, which keeps source and target aligned.
blocks.zh:
教师对每个源图像进行一次编辑,每个线下基线有50个取样步骤和2号指导。
我们选择了指导2 2,在指导1 1 、 2 2 和 5 5 的50 个步骤(图 S4 ) 上提供训练框架。 在指南1 1 中, 老师可以让编辑未完成, 如要求的皱眉或头转弯 。 在指导 5 5 中,它通过夸大表达式,去除指令未提及的对象,或者在背景变化中移动相机来过度编辑. 指导 2 2 是这两种失败模式之间的妥协,并给出了稳定的编辑,在没有这些副作用的情况下完成图S4中的所有三个例子.
老师将输入的大小调整到一个固定的一面桶和不合适的中收相上,所以我们先将源头剪到那个桶上,然后将学生训练到被收成的源头上,使源头和目标保持一致.

blocks.en:
We test whether the gains carry over to IVEBench [ 12 ] , whose clips, instructions, and metrics differ from those of OpenVE-Bench. As in Section 4.4 , we evaluate the jointly trained I2VT-1.3B, I2VT-14B, and I2VT-CoF on its short-video subset. I2VT achieves state-of-the-art results on IVEBench ( Table S4 ). On the short subset, I2VT-14B ranks first overall and in instruction compliance among the editors on the official leaderboard and AVE [ 84 ] .
The overall score averages video quality, instruction compliance, and fidelity, so editors with weak compliance can still score close to the top. Ditto, for example, scores 66.7 66.7 on IVEBench, close to I2VT-1.3B ( 68.9 68.9 ), but 2.13 2.13 on OpenVE-Bench against 3.42 3.42 ( Table 3 ).
IVEBench computes video quality from four temporal consistency metrics and a single-frame aesthetic score ( Table 9 ).

blocks.en: Appendix G OpenVE++
blocks.zh: 附录 G OpenVE++

blocks.en:
OpenVE++ contains 207 clips in four groups: Action Change (73 clips with head, gaze, and arm edits), Expression Change (42), Body Movement (42), and Scene Relighting (50, with 35 light types and 10 directions, phrased differently from the training data). Overall is the mean of the four group means.
The source clips come from OpenVE-3M videos that no training pool uses, so OpenVE++ follows the CC BY-NC 4.0 license of OpenVE-3M.
For the action, expression, and body-movement groups, a VLM checks that the first frame suits the edit, and we check that the requested change does not already appear later in the clip.
For relighting, Qwen3.5-27B [ 67 ] checks that the requested light would visibly change the clip, that the clip is not already lit that way, and that the light fits the scene. Finally, we check every case of the four groups by hand. Figure S5 shows edits of Bernini-R-1.3B on OpenVE++.
blocks.zh:
OpenVE++包含分四组的207个片段: 动作改变(73个片段有头,目,臂等编辑),表达改变(42),身体运动(42),和场景回光(50,有35个光型和10个方向,措辞与训练数据不同). 总的来说,这四组人的意思是:
源片段出自OpenVE-3M视频,没有训练池使用,因此OpenVE++遵循了OpenVE-3M的CC BY-NC 4.0许可.
对于动作,表达和体动组,一个VLM检查第一个帧是否适合编辑,我们检查请求的更改是否已经出现在剪辑后期.
为重燃,Quen3.5-27B [67] 检查所请求的光线会明显地改变剪辑,剪辑尚未以这种方式被点燃,而光线适合现场. 最后,我们用手检查四个小组的每一个案件。 图S5显示了OpenVE++上的伯尼尼-R-1.3B的编辑.

Asked to lower the woman’s head (top left), the base editor adds a cap, and asked to raise the man’s arm (top middle), it adds another person’s arm.

blocks.en: Table S6 : OpenVE++ and other video editing benchmarks. ✓ \checkmark : a dedicated category. ∘ \circ : a few cases in a broader category. × \times : no coverage.
blocks.zh: 表 S6: OpenVE++和其他视频编辑基准. \\ checkmark : 专用类别 。 \\circ :少数病例属于更宽泛的类别. \\时间:没有覆盖。

blocks.en:
Table S6 compares OpenVE++ with three recent benchmarks. Single Edit means that each instruction asks for one edit, and Open Source means that the test set is public. OpenVE++ will be released with the paper.
IVEBench [ 12 ] puts motion edits, including six laughing or crying edits, into one Subject Motion Editing category and has no lighting edits.
CoVEBench [ 91 ] covers expressions, actions, and lighting changes, but 583 of its 626 instructions combine several edits, so its marks in Table S6 count only the 43 single-edit instructions. None of its lighting edits specifies a light type and direction.
Goku-Bench [ 47 ] has a Subject Movement category without expression or lighting edits, and its test set has not been released.
OpenVE++ gives each of the four task groups its own category and asks for one edit per instruction, so each group score measures one ability.
blocks.zh:
表S6将OpenVE++与最近的三个基准进行比较. 单身 编辑指每个指令要求一个编辑,而开源指测试集是公开的. OpenVE++将随纸张一起发布.
IVE Bench [12] 将运动编辑,包括六个取笑或哭泣的编辑,放入一个主题运动编辑类,没有照明编辑.
CoVE Bench [91] 涵盖了表达式,动作和照明变化,但其626个指令中的583个组合了好几种编辑,因此其在表S6中的标记只计算43个单编辑指令. 它的照明编辑中,没有一个指定了灯光类型和方向.
Goku-Bench [47] 有一个主题移动类别,没有表达或照明编辑,其测试集尚未发布.
OpenVE++给出了四个任务组中的每一个各自的类别,并要求每个指令一个编辑,所以每个组的分数都衡量一个能力.

blocks.en: Appendix H User Study
blocks.zh: 附录H 用户研究

blocks.en:
We run a user study to check whether people also prefer I2VT edits over those of the base editors on OpenVE++.
For each of the four task groups, we select four OpenVE++ clips and compare two pairs of editors from Table 3 : Bernini-R-1.3B with I2VT-1.3B, and Bernini-R-14B with I2VT-14B.
Each of 20 participants judges 16 pairs of edits, two clips per task group for each editor pair. For every pair, a participant chooses which edit is better overall or calls a tie, without separate criteria.
The participants are volunteers recruited from the authors’ acquaintances, and we record only their choices, with no names, contact details, or other personal data. No IRB or equivalent body reviewed the study, since it studies nothing about the participants themselves, and the participants agreed to take part without a written consent form.
blocks.zh:
我们运行一个用户研究来检查人们是否也喜欢OpenVE++上的I2VT编辑而不是基础编辑.
对于四个任务小组,我们各自从表3中选择了4个OpenVE++剪辑并比较了两对编辑器:伯尼尼-R-1.3B与I2VT-1.3B,伯尼尼-R-14B与I2VT-14B.
20名参与者每人评出16对编辑,每对编辑每组各2个剪辑. 对于每对,参与者选择哪个编辑总体上更好,或者称平分,而没有单独的标准.
我们只记录他们的选择,没有姓名、联系方式或其他个人资料。 没有一个IRB或同等机构审查该研究,因为它没有研究参与者本身,参与者同意在没有书面同意表的情况下参加。

blocks.en: Table S7 : User study on OpenVE++. Participants prefer I2VT over the base editor in every task group. Each cell is the percentage of the 40 judgments (160 in the last row) in which I2VT wins, ties, or loses.
blocks.zh: 表S7:OpenVE++上的用户研究. 参与者倾向于I2VT,而不是每个任务组中的基础编辑器. 每个单元格是I2VT赢取,领带或输取的40个判决(上行为160个)的百分比.

blocks.en:
Participants prefer I2VT over the base editor in every task group at both sizes ( Table S7 ).
I2VT-1.3B wins 68.1% of its 160 judgments and loses 6.9%. Against the stronger Bernini-R-14B, I2VT-14B wins 50.6% and loses 15.0%, and more of its judgments end in a tie, most of all for body movements (50.0%).
This preference agrees in direction with the Gemini 2.5 Pro scores on OpenVE++ in Table 3 .

参与者倾向于I2VT,而不是每个任务组的基版编辑器,两者大小均相同(表S7.
I2VT-1.3B赢得了160个判决中的68.1%,损失了6.9%. 与实力更强的伯尼尼-R-14B相比,I2VT-14B胜出50.6%并损失了15.0%,其更多的判断以平分结束,其中最重要的是身体运动(50.0%).

blocks.en: Appendix I Evaluation Details
blocks.zh: 附录一 评价细节

blocks.en: We follow the OpenVE-Bench protocol [ 24 ] , whose authors report close agreement with human judgment. For each edit, the Gemini judge receives the source video followed by the edited video as two video-file inputs, with a category-specific scoring prompt supplied as the system instruction. We upload the complete videos without local frame extraction and leave the temperature at the API default for the Gemini 2.5 Pro runs.
blocks.zh: 我们遵循OpenVE-Bench协议[24],其作者报告与人类判断的密切一致. 每次编辑时,双子座法官都会收到源视频,然后是经过编辑的视频作为两个视频文件输入,一个特定类别的评分提示作为系统指令提供. 我们上传完整的视频 无需本地帧提取 并离开温度 在API默认 双子座2.5 Pro运行。

blocks.en: The prompts, including those for OpenVE++ in Appendix J , rate instruction compliance, consistency with the source, and visual quality from 1 to 5 [ 39 , 112 ] . They penalize flickering and other temporal artifacts according to the category-specific rubric, and instruct the evaluator not to assign consistency or quality scores above instruction compliance. We average the three ratings for each clip, then average clip scores within each category and category means for Overall.
blocks.zh: 提示,包括附录J中的OpenVE++的提示,符合标准指令,与源一致,视觉质量从1到5[39,112]. 它们根据特定类别对闪烁物和其他时间性文物进行处罚,并指示评价人员不要在遵守指令的基础上分配一致性或质量分数。 我们平均每个片段的3个收视率,然后是每一类中的平均收视分数,然后是“总体”的分数。

blocks.en: For comparisons with published editors, we report five OpenVE-Bench categories: Global Style , Local Change , Background Change , Local Remove , and Local Add , following the five-category comparison of prior work such as Kiwi-Edit [ 49 ] and JoyAI-Video-Edit [ 95 ] .
blocks.zh: 为了与已出版的编辑进行比较,我们报告5个OpenVE-Bench类:全球样式、本地变化、背景变化、本地删除、本地添加。

blocks.en:
For the unmarked rows of existing editors in Table 3 , we take VACE, OpenVE-Edit, ICVE, Ditto, and Lucy-Edit scores from the OpenVE-3M table “Quantitative Comparison on OpenVE-Bench with Gemini 2.5 Pro” (Table 3 of arXiv v2) [ 24 ] , and Kiwi-Edit scores from Table 2 of Kiwi-Edit [ 49 ] . VInO scores come from its Table 7 [ 11 ] and LoomVideo scores from its OpenVE-Bench comparison [ 90 ] . We count VInO as 17B, its 13B HunyuanVideo generation backbone plus its Qwen3-VL-4B encoder [ 11 ] .
We map columns by category name and recompute Overall as the mean of the five reported categories.
We evaluate the starred rows (Bernini-R-1.3B, VideoCoF, Bernini-R-14B, and JoyAI-Video-Edit) with this OpenVE-Bench protocol, running each with the default inference settings of its official repository.
blocks.zh:
对于表3中现有编辑器的无标记行,我们从"OpenVE-Bench与双子座2.5 Pro的定量比较"(arXiv v2表3 [24])的OpenVE-Edit,ICVE,Ditto,和Lucy-Edit中得分,Kiwi-Edit中得分从Kiwi-Edit [49]表2中得分. VINO分出自其表7 [11],LoomVideo分出自其OpenVE-Bench比较[90]. 我们把VINO算作17B,它的13BHunyuanVideo生成骨干加上它的Quen3-VL-4B编码器[11].

blocks.en: 1. The face is destroyed: melted features, doubled mouths, broken teeth or eyes, or heavy flicker.
blocks.zh: 1. 联合国 面部被破坏:被熔化的特征,双口相接,牙齿或眼睛被打碎,或被猛烈地闪烁.

blocks.en: 2. Obvious facial distortion, unstable features between frames, or distracting artifacts around the mouth and eyes.
blocks.zh: 2. 联合国 明显的面部扭曲,相框之间不稳定的特征,或者转移了口腔和眼睛周围的文物.

blocks.en: 3. Acceptable but with visible local artifacts on the face or mild frame-to-frame wobble.
blocks.zh: 3个 可接受,但表面有明显的当地文物,或有轻度相框至相框的摇摆.

blocks.en: 4. Clean and stable, with only minor imperfections in fine facial detail.
blocks.zh: 4. 清洁而稳定,面部细微细节中只有细小的缺陷.

blocks.en: 5. Natural and photographic throughout, with skin, teeth and eyes rendered convincingly and no flicker.
blocks.zh: 5 (韩语). 自然和相片, 皮肤,牙齿和眼睛 令人信服和没有闪烁。

blocks.en: Consistency & Detail Fidelity
blocks.zh: 一致性细节( D) 忠诚

blocks.en: 1. The person has been replaced, or hair, clothing, background or camera viewpoint are heavily changed.
blocks.zh: 1. 联合国 该人已被替换,或者头发、衣服、背景或相机视角被大幅改变。

blocks.en: 2. Identity drifts noticeably, or the head pose, framing or background changes along with the expression.
blocks.zh: 2. 身份可明显地漂移,或头部摆出、布局或背景变化以及表达方式。

blocks.en: 3. The person remains recognizable but with unintended changes to face shape, hair, or surroundings.
blocks.zh: 3个 此人仍然可以辨认,但面对外形、发型或周围情况会有出乎意料的变化。

blocks.en: 4. Identity, head pose, clothing, background and camera viewpoint are nearly all preserved.
blocks.zh: 4.四. 身份、头姿、服装、背景和相机视角几乎都保留下来。

blocks.en: 5. Only the expression changes; the same person, the same head pose, the same clothing, background and camera viewpoint.
blocks.zh: 5 (韩语). 只有表达方式改变;同一个人,同头相姿,同衣相貌,同背景相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相

blocks.en: Prompt 3: Evaluation Prompt of Body Movement
blocks.zh: 快速3:评价快速身体移动

blocks.en: You are a data rater specializing in grading video edits that make a visible person perform a whole-body movement – jumping, crouching, standing up, sitting down, or turning to face the other way – while the camera stays where it was.
blocks.zh: 你是一个数据评分员,专门对视频进行分级编辑,使可见人物能够进行全身运动 — — 跳跃、蹲倒、站起、坐起、坐起、或转过身来 — — 而相机则停留在原地。

blocks.en: Instruction Compliance
blocks.zh: 指令遵守情况

blocks.en: 1. The person does not move, performs a different movement, or the camera moves or cuts instead.
blocks.zh: 1. 联合国 该人不移动,不进行不同的移动,或者相机移动或切口取而代之.

blocks.en: 2. A movement is attempted but it is the wrong one, only partially carried out, or achieved by zooming, panning or re-framing rather than by the person moving.
blocks.zh: 2. 联合国 试图进行一项运动,但这是错误的,只是部分进行,或者通过放大、平板或再烧而实现,而不是由移动者实现。

blocks.en: 3. The requested movement is recognizable but incomplete, in the wrong direction, or the body does not follow through the way the instruction implies.
blocks.zh: 3个 请求的移动可以识别但不完整,方向错误,或者机体不遵循指令的含义.

blocks.en: 4. The requested movement is carried out correctly with minor errors in extent, timing, or balance.
blocks.zh: 4.四. 要求的移动是正确的,在范围、时间或平衡方面有小错误。

blocks.en: 5. The requested movement is performed fully and plausibly, with the whole body following through, and the camera unchanged.
blocks.zh: 5 (韩语). 所要求的移动是完全和合理的,整个身体通过,相机不变。

blocks.en: Visual Quality & Stability
blocks.zh: 视觉质量和稳定性

blocks.en: 1. Limbs detach, duplicate or melt; the body is unusable or the clip is badly corrupted.
blocks.zh: 1. 联合国 林布斯分解出,复制出或熔化出;身体无法使用或夹被严重腐蚀.

blocks.en: 2. Obvious anatomical breakage during the movement, or heavy jitter as the pose changes.
blocks.zh: 2. 联合国 明显的解剖功能在运动中断裂,或者随着姿势的变化而变得很紧张.

blocks.en: 3. Acceptable but with visible distortion at the joints, feet or hands while moving.
blocks.zh: 3个 可接受但移动时在关节、脚或手上明显扭曲。

blocks.en: 4. Clean and stable through the movement with only minor artifacts.
blocks.zh: 4. 通过运动保持清洁和稳定,只有少量文物。

blocks.en: 5. Anatomically sound and temporally smooth from start to finish.
blocks.zh: 5 (韩语). 从解剖学上讲,从开始到结束,时间上都是平滑的。

blocks.en: Consistency & Detail Fidelity
blocks.zh: 一致性细节( D) 忠诚

blocks.en: 1. The person is replaced, or the room, floor, furniture or camera viewpoint are rebuilt around the movement.
blocks.zh: 1. 联合国 人员被替换,或者在运动周围重建房间,地板,家具或相机视角.

blocks.en: 2. Identity or surroundings change noticeably, or the framing shifts to accommodate the new pose.
blocks.zh: 2. 身份或周围环境明显改变,或为适应新的姿势而设定的转变。

blocks.en: 3. The scene survives but with unintended changes to clothing, nearby objects, or the person’s proportions.
blocks.zh: 3个 现场幸存下来,但服装、相邻物品或人的比例有意外变化。

blocks.en: 4. Identity, clothing, background and camera viewpoint are nearly all preserved through the movement.
blocks.zh: 4.四. 身份、衣服、背景和相机观点几乎都通过运动得到保存。

blocks.en: 5. Only the person’s pose changes; identity, clothing, the surrounding scene and the camera viewpoint are untouched.
blocks.zh: 5 (韩语). 只有人物的姿势变化;身份,服装,周围的场景和相机视角都不受影响.

blocks.en: Prompt 4: Evaluation Prompt of Scene Relighting
blocks.zh: 提示 4: 评价 提示

blocks.en: You are a data rater specializing in grading video relighting edits. You will be given two videos (before and after editing) and the editing instruction.
blocks.zh: 您是一个数据评分器, 专门对视频重新点亮编辑 。 您将获得两段视频(编辑前后)和编辑指令。

blocks.en: Instruction Compliance
blocks.zh: 指令遵守情况

blocks.en: 1. Lighting is unchanged, changed in the wrong direction/style, or the edit is unrelated.
blocks.zh: 1. 联合国 照明没有改变,方向/风格改变错误,或者编辑无关.

blocks.en: 2. The requested lighting appears only weakly, in the wrong area, or with major style mismatch.
blocks.zh: 2. 联合国 要求的取出灯光的外观只有微弱,出现在错误的区域,或者出现重大风格不匹配.

blocks.en: 3. The requested lighting is recognizable but incomplete, inconsistent, or mixed with incorrect illumination.
blocks.zh: 3个 所要求的照明可以识别,但不完整、不一致或与不正确的照明相混合。

blocks.en: 4. The requested lighting is applied well with only minor intensity, direction, or color inaccuracies.
blocks.zh: 4.四. 所要求照明的应用良好,其强度、方向或颜色不准确。

blocks.en: 5. The lighting exactly matches the requested style and direction while preserving the original scene content.
blocks.zh: 5 (韩语). 照明完全符合要求的样式和方向,同时保留了原场景内容.

blocks.en: Visual Quality & Stability
blocks.zh: 视觉质量和稳定性

blocks.en: 1. Severe flicker, artifacts, blown-out regions, or unusable video.
blocks.zh: 1. 联合国 严重闪烁,文物,被吹出区域, 或无法使用的视频。

blocks.en: 2. Distracting temporal instability, inconsistent shadows, or obvious relighting artifacts.
blocks.zh: 2. 联合国 分散时间的不稳定性,不一致的阴影,或者明显地重燃了文物.

blocks.en: 3. Mostly stable but with visible lighting flicker, halos, or local artifacts.
blocks.zh: 3个 大部分是稳定的,但有可见的灯光闪烁器、光环或当地文物。

blocks.en: 4. Stable and clean relighting with only minor artifacts.
blocks.zh: 4. 仅用小件文物进行稳定和清洁的再照明。

blocks.en: 5. Perfectly stable, natural illumination, shadows, and color across the whole video.
blocks.zh: 5 (韩语). 完全稳定 自然发光 影子 整个视频的颜色

blocks.en: Consistency & Detail Fidelity
blocks.zh: 一致性细节( D) 忠诚

blocks.en: 1. Objects, identity, materials, motion, or camera viewpoint are heavily changed.
blocks.zh: 1. 联合国 物体、身份、材料、运动或相机视角都大有改变。

blocks.en: 2. Important scene details or geometry are changed while relighting.
blocks.zh: 2. 联合国 重要的场景细节或几何在重燃的同时被改变.

blocks.en: 3. Main content is preserved but with noticeable unintended changes.
blocks.zh: 3个 主要内容得到保留,但有明显的意外变化。

blocks.en: 4. Nearly all unrelated details, motion, and camera viewpoint are preserved.
blocks.zh: 4.四. 几乎所有不相关的细节,运动和相机视角都被保留.

blocks.en: 5. Only lighting changes; all scene content, motion, materials, and camera viewpoint are perfectly preserved.
blocks.zh: 5 (韩语). 只有照明改变;所有场景内容,运动,材料,相机视角都得到完美保存.
